# Texas terminates contract with primary foster care provider **Published** July 22, 2026 8:32 PM CDT **DALLAS** - Just four months after taking over the operations of its primary foster care provider, Texas has decided to terminate its contract with the nonprofit organization\. What we know: The Texas Department of Family and Protective Services has terminated its contract with EMPOWER, the state's primary foster care provider\. The state says children weren't receiving the care they deserve under EMPOWER's oversight\. Two children have died since EMPOWER took over foster care for Texas\. The nonprofit organization faced chronic staffing shortages and high turnover among caseworkers since taking full oversight\. The state took over EMPOWER's operations in March\. Recently, the Texas Attorney General's Office filed a motion to continue the state takeover until at least October\. What's next: Though EMPOWER's contract has been terminated, Texas state law requires a six-month transition period\. # Mercy Care to host tech assistance workshop for older adults in Tupper Lake Mercy Care Friendship Volunteers and elders participate in a Mercy Care Technology Assistance workshop\. Photo courtesy of Mercy Care\. With support from charitable donors and private foundations, Mercy Care for the Adirondacks is scaling up its programs to empower seniors to access digital devices and provide instruction on use through its iPad permanent loan program\. This new digital initiative empowers older adults to stay connected with their community, family and friends while also facilitating access to telemedicine, essential information and entertainment\. Mercy Care for the Adirondacks will host a Technology Assistance Workshop open to all older adults from 9:30 a\.m\.–12 p\.m\. on Thursday, Aug\. 20 at the Adirondack Adult Center in Tupper Lake\. Refreshments will be served\. On a first-come, first-served basis, Mercy Care will provide elders with a permanently loaned iPads and one-on-one technology assistance with cell phones and tablets\.
